units.position: local ENU metres, public map vertical datum
units.human_oxygen: equivalent ideal dry O2 litres at 273.15 K and 101.325 kPa
units.robot_oxygen: absent internally, ROS NaN, JSON null

tolerance_scope: Existing finite cost comparison/transport bounds only; no scientific model equivalence, resource slack, geometry clearance or localization claim

schedule_binding.primary_meaning: stationary visual observation/check-in; no optional inspection task completion
schedule_binding.wire_policy: Keep existing ROS fields. Agree config/request context binding with consumers before runtime adoption; no field or context is invented by this kit.

accounting.movement: Sum directed estimate_segment costs on the exact returned path, including any approved connector once
accounting.stationary: Use estimate_activity separately for every explicit service/wait interval; do not merge different activities
accounting.remaining: Consumed travel/completed work is not charged again; replanning uses current remaining resources and unfinished service
accounting.reserves: Initial allocation minus consumed and candidate remaining costs must retain each separate reserve; boundary uses strict nonnegative margin without tolerance credit

closure_requires: Diego-owned executable backend reproduces the scientific API or an explicitly reviewed alternative with justified error bounds
Same supplied path and activity schedule yield matching time, energy and applicable oxygen, with model/profile/config/source hashes
Flat, ascent, descent, zero, invalid ground vertical, activities, waiting, connectors, full return, partial service, resource boundaries and sensitivity cases checked
Actual mission/service consumer preserves request identity, remaining resources and schedule binding
David reviews numeric evidence and profiles separately; Jesus reviews wiring; no flag substitutes for missing evidence
